decisions.reason: The flagship management platform anchors the agency-focused strategy in a growing market, so it meets aspirations and justifies continued investment of slack resources.
The configurable managed plan builds cheaply on existing infrastructure and has its own page, and with no evident performance shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search or withdrawal.

Extended PHP security support supports the firm's security and compliance promise at low incremental cost, but it is only lightly featured and tied to legacy PHP versions, so it carries a somewhat higher risk of being phased out.
